label: Global mirror image: spatial reflection P or CPT conjugation
resolution: MIRROR_1 is spatial reflection P (SpatialReflection), MIRROR_2 is CPT conjugation (CPTConjugation); they are distinct Lean types, so a premise stated for one cannot be used for the other. Both are intended to reverse spatial handedness; whether the CPT image of w does is the open premise 314f6b15. They differ consequentially for the preservation premise: on dispositional essentialism the P-image of the actual world violates creaturely law-natures (the weak interaction is not P-invariant), while the CPT image does not. The registered mirror argument (contingentFromChiralMirror) takes MIRROR_2 in all three mirror premises (EssentialTruthsPreservedByCPTAt, HandednessReversedByCPTAt, ChiralAtCPTImageAt) and declares term_senses MIRROR = MIRROR_2; no registered argument uses MIRROR_1 and no argument passes between the senses. The generic premises and the fork certificate range over any world map (DEF 3fc924f3) and are not tagged with either sense.
